segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The heavy wooden door of the Rusty Anchor groans open, letting in a bitter gust of mountain wind that makes the tallow candles gutter.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael steps inside, shedding the gloom of the haunted village, his chain mail clinking softly in the dim, smoke-filled room.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Two scruffy figures clad in mismatched leather armor leap up from a corner table, crude scimitars instantly flashing in the candlelight.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Goblin Scout "Fresh meat! Cut him down before the others get here!"

suggestions.text: Draw your longsword and ready your shield to face the goblins
Charge forward and strike the Goblin Scout first
Shout a challenge to draw their attention away from the tavern patrons

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael's hand sweeps down with practiced ease, his longsword clearing the scabbard with a clean, lethal ring of steel.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He lunges across the warped floorboards, bringing the blade down in a heavy, arcing slash toward the Goblin Scout.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The goblin shrieks, raising its crude scimitar just a fraction too late as Kael's steel bites deep into leather and flesh.

suggestions.text: Follow up with a shield bash to knock the wounded scout off balance
Keep the pressure on the Goblin Scout with a second sword strike
Pivot and swing your blade defensively to cover against the Raider

turns.action: I draw my sword and attack the Goblin Scout!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael steps into the follow-up strike, pivoting his hips to put the weight of his mail behind the blade.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: His longsword whistles through the smoke-choked air, catching the Goblin Scout squarely across the chest.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The small creature lets out a sharp gasp, its eyes rolling back as it collapses lifelessly onto the tavern floorboards.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Goblin Raider "You'll pay for that, you bastard!"

suggestions.text: Turn your attention and your blade toward the remaining Goblin Raider
Taunt the surviving goblin to draw its desperate charge
Raise your shield and wait for the Goblin Raider to make the first move

turns.action: I swing again at the Goblin Scout!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: With the scout dealt with, Kael glances at the remaining raider who is snarling with jagged teeth bared.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Kael reaches into his belt pouch and unstoppered the glass vial of crimson liquid, downing the medicinal brew in a single gulp.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The warm, tingling sensation washes through his tired limbs, soothing away the minor aches from the scuffle.
